fullDescription: A professional developer-centric dashboard design system featuring a clean, high-contrast aesthetic with ASIN green (#16b674) accents and ASIN blue (#2B6B8E) branding. Optimized for SaaS platforms, cloud management consoles, and technical administrative tools. The system utilizes Plus Jakarta Sans for a modern editorial feel, featuring collapsible sidebars, status-based badge systems, and interactive sandbox management cards with subtle elevation and smooth cubic-bezier transitions.
prompt:
## Resumo
Modern developer dashboard with a collapsible navigation sidebar, fixed header, and a multi-state grid of functional management cards. The UI emphasizes clarity through status badges, high-quality typography, and distinct action-oriented components.

## Estilo Visual
### Visual Identity System\n- **Primary Colors**: ASIN Green (#16b674) for primary buttons, success states, and active icons. Neutral Border (#efefef). Primary Text (#1a1a1a). Secondary Text (#666666).\n- **Typography**: Primary Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Use 600 weight for headings (16px) and 500-600 for UI labels (13px-14px). Monospaced font for code/URLs: 11px sized with light gray background (#fcfcfc).\n- **Surface & Elevation**: Backgrounds are white (#ffffff). Borders are 1px solid (#efefef). Card radius: 12px. Button radius: 8px. Hover elevation: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.14).\n- **Animation**: All transitions (sidebar toggle, dropdowns, card hovers) must follow `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` with a duration of 300ms.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Header
Height: 64px. Background: White. Border-bottom: 1px solid #efefef. Left section: Hamburger menu (mobile only), Logo (32px height), Page Title. Right section: CTA Button ('Nouvelle Sandbox'), Notification icon with red dot, Profile Dropdown containing Avatar (circular, #16b674 bg) and user name.

### Collapsible Sidebar
Width: Transitions from 80px (collapsed) to 260px (expanded). Background: #fcfcfc. Items: Vertical list of nav links with 24px icons. Active state: 10% opacity green background with solid green text/icon. Bottom: 'Chevrons-left/right' toggle button with a top border line.

### KPI Section
Layout: 3-column responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet). Cards: Gradient background (White to #f9fafb), 20px padding. Content: Large 32px bold value, 13px label, and a bottom-aligned status indicator or trend text. Include a 40px faded icon (30% opacity) in the top-right corner.

### Resource Management Grid
Section Title: 16px bold text with a sorting dropdown (12px text). Grid: 3-column layout for resource cards. Spacing: 24px (6 units) gap between elements.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Resource Card — Functional cards with status indicators and action groups.
Structure: 12px radius, 1px #efefef border. Accent: 3px solid #16b674 on the left edge. Header: Title (15px bold) + Status Badge. Content: Two lines of metadata (13px) including a monospaced URL block. Footer: Button group with 'Ouvrir' (Primary Green), 'Redéployer' (Outline), and 'Supprimer' (Danger Red text on hover). Hover: translateY(-4px) and increased shadow depth.

### Status Badge System — Multi-colored semantic badges for system states.
Format: 12px bold text, 6px padding-x, 10px padding-y, 6px radius. Styles: 1. Running (12% alpha green, solid green dot/text). 2. Building (12% alpha blue, pulsing blue dot). 3. Idle (10% alpha gray, gray dot). 4. Failed (12% alpha red, red dot).

### Profile Dropdown Menu — Animated user settings menu.
Width: 200px. Position: Absolute, top-right of header. Animation: TranslateY(-10px) to (0) with Opacity 0 to 1. Items: 13px text, 12px icons. Include a 1px #efefef divider before the 'Logout' item. Logout item must have #ef4444 color on hover.

style.description: Minimalist premium theme with a focus on 'ASIN Green' (#16b674) for primary actions and 'ASIN Blue' (#2B6B8E) for branding. Typography uses Plus Jakarta Sans across all weights (400-700). Shadows are light and layered (0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)). Animations use a standard 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for all expansions and hover states.
